prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Full SCENE STATE SHEET for a physical Mars expedition game. Match the supplied realistic painterly cream-and-teal machinery, ochre landscape, restrained cobalt science equipment, mustard rover fittings. Locally made parts are simple cut straight steel and bolted joints, never elaborate molded industrial machinery. Factory precision parts are imported. No people, text, numerals, labels, captions, borders, arrows, diagrams or UI. Each panel repeats EXACTLY the same camera, framing, object positions, light, room/landscape and perspective, changing ONLY the specified state. Every recurring object is the same actual object. Frame the full installation in the upper two thirds; lower third is quiet natural floor or ground for the movable inventory. No loose decorative objects. Whole scenes will be cropped into registered fixed targets; keep independent working regions clearly separated. Square panels, not portrait strips.
Layout: 3 columns by 1 rows of equal SQUARE scenes. Reading order left to right then next row. The same actual three-zone cave farm from the last panel of reference 1, after growth. Match its room, camera, bed structure, dark potato skirt, reservoir, drains, freshwater hose and lights. Potato bed at left; soybean row at back; shallow lettuce tray at right. Add only a small clean preparation basin on the extreme right wall beyond the lettuce, never a whole kitchen. Each growing region must remain visually separate for independent changes.
STATE 1: Leafy potato plants in the left LOW-SIDED bay, with medium just below its low rim; soybean stems at the back are upright but beginning to lean and have NO trellis. The right lettuce tray has green leaves ready to pick. No mature dry bean pods or exposed potato tubers.
STATE 2: A simple additional bolted collar extends the left potato bay sides upward, but its granular medium level is still LOW within the new collar. Same potato foliage. Soybeans still have no trellis. Lettuce unchanged.
STATE 3: The extended potato bay is now filled higher with clean medium around the lower stems; foliage stays above the new rim. Thin straight steel uprights and clean cloth ties support the back soybean row. Lettuce and basin unchanged.
